# Property Name

#### Name

Gets the name of PDM (i.e. the localized name of PDM connection).

##### Declaration

```
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 17, 400, 60)]
string Name { get; }
```

##### Property Value

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  string |   |  

##### Remarks

This property is available since v7.17 SP3.
